route: catalog.archives.gov public IIIF Image API v3 (no key needed): item page discovered via the site's own React search UI (headless Chromium, tools/browser_fetch.js; plain curl to catalog.archives.gov/search or /proxy/records/search returns only the app shell), image URLs read from the item page's embedded IIIF manifest data. Fetched at each frame's own native resolution via .../full/<w>,<h>/0/default.jpg (info.json gives width/height/maxArea per frame; requesting a size wider than a frame's own native width, e.g. a fixed 3300px for all four, silently returns the site's HTML error shell at HTTP 200 for the frames narrower than that -- fetch each frame at its own info.json dimensions, not a fixed guess).
